tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: At this time, Air Pacifica flight 8-1-8 to Taipei is ready to begin boarding. I'd like to ask all passengers seated in first class to please come forward to board at this time. Once the first-class passengers are onboard, we'll call for the remaining passengers by seat number. Make sure to have your boarding pass out, and please show your passport or other valid photo ID to the boarding agent. Again, we're now starting the boarding process for Air Pacifica flight 8-1-8 to Taipei.

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that a research firm is doing a telephone survey of people in your city. You have agreed to answer some questions about sports.

questions.question: What sports do you enjoy playing?
questions.modelAnswer: I enjoy playing badminton and swimming because they provide a fantastic full-body workout and help relieve stress.

questions.question: How often do you usually play sports?
questions.modelAnswer: I usually play badminton twice a week, on Tuesday evenings and Sunday mornings with my colleagues.

questions.question: Do you think it is important for children to play sports? Why or why not?
questions.modelAnswer: Yes, I believe it is essential for children to play sports because it builds strong physical fitness, instills discipline, and teaches valuable teamwork and communication skills from an early age.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided
Hi. I'm interested in some of the city tours that your company is offering during the month of May. I saw your advertisement, but I'd like to ask you for some additional information, if you don’t mind.
Question 8: When is the tour that goes to some of the city’s parks, and what is its title?
Question 9: I think 4 tours are offered and they all cost 15 dollars. Is that right?
Question 10: I’d really like to participate in all of the tours you’re offering, but my schedule won’t allow it. Instead, I’m trying to decide between the “City Science” and “Nature in the City” tours. Could you describe these in detail?

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Imagine that there is a plan to build a large shopping mall in your neighborhood. Do you support or oppose this plan? Why? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
